subject: Procurement portal onboarding refresh & seat uplift
messages:
From: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-portal@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement: onboarding refresh + seat uplift

Hi Olga / Jonas,

We're finalizing our renewal for Acme's internal AI platform and need to refresh vendor onboarding in your procurement portal before our PO can be raised. We are increasing committed seats from 50 to 120 (mid-year ramp), and procurement wants the onboarding evidence pre-populated where possible so our legal and finance reviewers have everything in one place.

Can you confirm:
- Whether your portal supports auto-fill for SOC2/SLA attestations or a preloaded evidence bundle?
- If you can accept a single amended PO for the seat uplift and term change (18 months instead of 12)?
- Who on your side will own the portal upload / PO reconciliation?

We'd like to close this week if possible — our procurement lock window opens 6/4.

Thanks,
Jamie Lin
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: ACME_PO_template_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: onboarding refresh + seat uplift

Jonas / Karthik — looping you in.

Summary from Acme: +70 seats (50 -> 120), term extension to 18 months, wants procurement portal evidence pre-filled where possible and a single amended PO. They want to close this week.

Action items I think we need:
- Confirm portal support for preloaded evidence bundle (SOC2, data flow diagram, customer-specific attestations).
- Prepare an SOW amendment that shows the seat tiers + pricing matrix and new term. I'll draft the redline; Karthik can confirm pricing.
- Finance/Legal signoff path — any special approvals for >$500k ARR commit? Jonas, can you flag if we need a revenue recognition or legal review lane?

I'll start a draft SOW amendment and attach the PO template they sent. If portal auto-fill is not available, propose we upload a curated evidence ZIP and a one-page attest doc to speed their review.

Olga
Director, Renewals & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sow-amendment-draft.docx (docx)

Cc: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@acme-corp.com>, procure-portal@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-05-30T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: onboarding refresh + seat uplift

Thanks Olga — quick clarity from procurement side: our portal can accept either: (a) a pre-filled evidence bundle uploaded to a vendor record (preferred), or (b) a DocuSign chain with linked artifacts. Attached is the PO template they asked us to submit; finance will not start review until the vendor record shows the evidence bundle or a DocuSign package is in flight.

Portal link & instructions: https://acme.procure-portal.com/form/renewal-4781
DocuSign template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/9a2f
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-98432

We can also accept the SOW amendment as a short annex (one page) that calls out seat tiers and pricing and references the main MSA by number.

Jamie

Attachments: procure-portal-screenshot.png (png)

On May 30, 2026, at 10:05 AM, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jonas / Karthik — looping you in.
>
> Summary from Acme: +70 seats (50 -> 120)...

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: onboarding refresh + seat uplift

OLGA / JONAS — finance note: any amendment that pushes ARR over the $500k threshold needs VP finance approval and a modified billing schedule. If they move to 18 months, we need to confirm whether revenue is recognized monthly or upfront for internal forecasting. Also confirm whether Acme requires a PO for the full 18 months or will split into two releases (initial PO for immediate seats, follow-on PO at 12 months).

Proposal from my side:
- Provide two billing templates in the upload: (A) single amended PO (preferred by Acme) and (B) staggered PO schedule (if procurement insists). Finance will expedite approval if we include a clause for mid-term seat ramp (with clear trigger dates).
- Karthik to own finance touch and queue VP approval once SOW amendment + PO template are uploaded to Acme portal.

Forwarding the latest from Acme below for context.

On May 30, 2026, at 01:47 PM, Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Thanks Olga — quick clarity from procurement side: our portal can accept either...

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acme-corp.com>, Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@acme-corp.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: onboarding refresh + seat uplift

Jamie / Taylor — thanks for the clarity and the portal link. Confirming next steps and timeline from Redwood's side: 

1) Today (6/2): We will upload a curated evidence bundle to the Acme vendor record (SOC2 report excerpt, data flow diagram, one-page vendor attest). Attached is the SOW amendment redline and the PO template filled per your sample.
2) Finance path: Karthik will open the VP approval queue for the >$500k threshold once the DocuSign/SOW draft is in the portal; we expect signoff in 48 business hours once queued.
3) Billing: We'll present both the single-amendment PO and a staggered PO option in the upload. You choose which procurement flow you prefer.
4) Rollout: We propose a phased seat activation: 70 seats on day 1, remaining 0 -> 50 over week 4 (to allow for onboarding support). If Acme wants a faster ramp we can compress to week 2.

If that looks good, Jamie — please confirm you see the evidence bundle and PO on the portal and mark the HubSpot deal as "documents submitted". We'll route the DocuSign template once you confirm the single-amendment preference.

Olga
Director, Renewals & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_PO_template_v2.pdf (pdf), redwood-sow-amendment-draft.docx (docx)
